reference_source: GWTC-1 (Abbott 2019, PRX 9, 031040), Tables I and III

criteria.note: margin +0.4%; exceeding the reference is not a failure -- GWTC-1's value is the highest-RANKED template, not the highest-SNR one

criteria.tolerance: inside the propagated interval, or within 10% of the median
criteria.note: inside 90% interval: True; fractional offset from median +1.29%. Frame conversion applied (SPEC.md §6.2): (1+z) = 1.090

criteria.criterion: V2c recovered value not at a bank edge
criteria.note: catches a rail-pinned fit masquerading as a measurement

criteria.criterion: V2d bank spacing finer than the claimed tolerance
criteria.note: prevents claiming an agreement the bank's own resolution cannot support

criteria.criterion: V3a merger time vs published event time
criteria.note: compared in GPS against the API value for the published UTC, so no leap-second conversion is involved
internal consistency check; needs no published value

criteria.criterion: V3c GW150914 arrival order and delay
criteria.tolerance: L1 first, delay within the published interval (+/-1 ms allowance)
criteria.note: PRL 116 061102 -- the only published per-event delay
